title: sorbus aria subsp. latifolia
intro: Sorbus aria subsp. latifolia, commonly known as the Whitebeam or Mountain Ash, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree, native to the mountains of Europe and Western Asia. The health benefits of Sorbus aria subsp. latifolia include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, have been reported to possess therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, antiproliferative, and anti-cancer properties.
